The selected pages of this section cover Hawaii pedestrian fatality facts, the driver's and the pedestrian's legal and safety duties, stopping for a school bus, and sharing the road with bicyclists together with the rules and safety tips for riding a bicycle; they teach pedestrian, school bus and bicycle rules and say nothing about any examination; they state no exam name, question count, passing standard, format or time limit.

The run scope names the Hawaii Department of Transportation as the handbook issuer and the twenty twenty-three printing as the edition, but these pages carry no page-bound issuer or edition statement, so part A asserts no issuer or edition fact of its own.

Question count, passing standard, format and time limit for the class three knowledge test are not stated anywhere in this manual; every official exam fact stays unknown in this envelope and is never guessed.

Corpus note: the duties and the school bus law are statutory content printed in this twenty twenty-three edition, the crash percentages are statistics stated only as printed, and no annual-rewrite signal appears on these pages.
